hook: We have a big picnic today!
But my friends are all hiding!
episode.ask: Can you help me find them?

gag_lines: Ha ha! You got me, duck!
finds.action_line: The duck can flap! Can you flap too?
The owl can spin! Can you spin too?
The horse can stomp! Can you stomp too?

gag_lines: Ha ha! You got me, cow!
finds.action_line: The cow can dance! Can you dance too?
The chick can hop! Can you hop too?
The dog can wiggle! Can you wiggle too?
The rooster can flap! Can you flap too?

lines: Hop and jump and stomp your feet
Clap your hands and wave now
March and stretch up to the sky
Spin and clap and wiggle around

finale: Thank you for finding all my friends!
Thank you, friends! I love you!
episode.teaser_line: Next time, a new friend comes to play!
